plays.reason: SPY broke above 770 (the level shorts were said to defend) while fear/greed is 29 and Stocktwits is bearish at 29; IWM +2% shows broad risk appetite. Contrarian lean, but momentum already faded in the chop

readings.whats_new: SPY rose to 771.71 (+0.68%) from 766.87 and broke through 770, which the previous reading flagged as a squeeze level. VIX fell to 17.7 from 18.75 and fear/greed rose to 29 from 22, while Stocktwits stays bearish at 29. Small caps lead (IWM +2%); the US-Iran peace chatter was not seen this hour, and AI-infra worries now center on the Elice IPO.
